text: {"status": "answered", "answer": "Under the Overdraft Policy v3, Harbor Credit Union charges $29 per item paid through Courtesy Pay, up to a maximum of three items per business day. However, no overdraft fee is charged if the account is overdrawn by $25.00 or less at the end of the business day. If you use Overdraft Transfer Protection to transfer from a linked Primary Share Account, there is a $5.00 transfer fee per transfer (only one fee per business day regardless of how many items the transfer covers).", "cited_chunk_ids": ["overdraft_policy_v3::layout::B_structure::0004"], "reason": "The Overdraft Policy v3 directly specifies the current overdraft fees for retail accounts effective 2026-01-01."}
